scripts.test: npm test -w web && npm test -w functions
scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-liga-replay
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-liga-replay 'npx vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts'
scripts.e2e: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,hosting --project demo-liga-replay 'tsx scripts/seed.ts && playwright test'
scripts.dev:demo: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,hosting --project demo-liga-replay --ui 'tsx scripts/seed.ts && sleep 86400'
